findings.label: Agora chip label omits a unit mark
findings.detail: The 10-agorot chip prints a bare '10' while every other chip in both sets carries a currency mark (½₪, ₪1, 5¢). The Coin Info Map names and values it correctly, so meaning is recoverable. Optional future polish (e.g. '10a' / '10אג׳'); no action required for this phase.
